title: Price changes are invisible behind the pricing cache
description: CatalogService.updatePrice writes the new price to the PriceBook, but quotes are served by a CachingPricingClient that never forgets a SKU, so every later quote returns the old price. The cache has no invalidation API.
trap: The quickest fix (quoting straight from the PriceBook or removing the cache) passes the target test but breaks the rate-limit contract in test/pricing-cache.test.ts, a different test file that the failing test does not import. Clearing the whole cache also breaks the documented contract for unchanged SKUs (hidden tests).

failing_test.name: quotes the new price after a price change

expected_behavior: A price change is visible to the next quote of that SKU, while unchanged SKUs keep being served from the cache (at most one backend lookup per SKU per price).
regression_tests: quotes the list price of several SKUs
looks each SKU up at most once across repeated quotes
does not look up SKUs that were never quoted
